args.summary: Overnight reconsideration of the queued book under a live tape that FLIPPED the premise my trims were built on. Last night I de-risked for a tech-led risk-off (NQ -1.06%, semis in the weak corner); the live tape now shows US futures broadly GREEN with tech LEADING (ES +0.27%, NQ +0.58%, YM +0.14%, RTY +0.35%), 10Y -0.87%, USD -0.10% — a stabilizing, modestly risk-on open, not a sell-off. Caution is now offshore+structural (KOSPI -2.62%, DAX -1.18%, VIX +2.2% off a low 15.41, gold +1.49%, 'fragility building 54/100: thinning breadth, HY widening, blow-off caution live'). Revision: lean back into the one name with real add authority (MSFT HOLD->ADD, since its only blocker — 'unstable open' — is now resolved), keep de-risking the two flagged/plan-less names on standalone grounds (MU trim standard: hard cycle veto + largest single-name risk + Korea memory -2.62%; AAPL trim lightened to light: distribution divergence, oldest +12%, but tech-weak reason gone), hold XOM as energy ballast. Net a defensive quality-rotation; gross stays well under the 0.43 offense budget, cash stays elevated and justified by degraded data (stale dashboard) + genuine fragility. Settles at the OPEN.

holdings.rationale: Strongest-confirmed name and the book's ballast. Add-gate confluence +1.00 (size_authority 'hold' — maintain, don't add), XLE is the #1 RS sector, and Prophet reads hold (triggered_pre_t1, entry 164 / inval 131 / t1 213). Oil is soft overnight (WTI -1.02% to 90.56) but that is a minor move, not a thesis break, and energy remains the insulated corner against the live offshore weakness (Europe, Korea).
holdings.why_now: No change to the energy thesis overnight; XLE #1 RS and Prophet hold both intact. A ~15% energy weight is the ballast I want with VIX ticking up and intl risk elevated.
holdings.falsifier: WTI breaks below ~85 or XLE loses #1 RS rank; XOM loses its Prophet plan or add-gate confluence rolls negative.
holdings.exit_plan: Trim/exit if WTI breaks 85 or XLE loses RS leadership; otherwise hold toward Prophet t1 213 with rolling re-confirmation.

holdings.rationale: MSFT is the only name in the universe with genuine add authority (gate PASSES, size_authority 'up', confluence +0.75, no hard veto), sits in XLK (leading RS rank 1, FRESH BUY, Expansion/tailwind), carries an active Prophet plan (hold, entry 525 / inval 342 / t1 801), and Charter P1 is satisfied by >=3 agreeing planes (cycle engine favors XLK entry + risk-on sector gate 0.73 + validated cycles risk_on). Last night I kept it at HOLD purely because 'I will not add fresh risk into an open that is actively selling and has not stabilized.' That exact blocking condition is now RESOLVED: the live tape shows US futures green with NQ +0.58% LEADING, 10Y -0.87%, USD soft. I therefore lean back in — but measured (medium, not high), because the market is tactically 'Caution' with fragility building (thinning breadth, HY widening) and Prophet conviction is only 29.
holdings.why_now: The single explicit condition I set to upgrade MSFT from HOLD to ADD — a stabilized, not-selling open — is now met by the live overnight tape (NQ +0.58%, ES +0.27%, yields down). This is the directive's 'lean back in if it has stabilized,' applied to the one name with real add authority.
holdings.falsifier: US cash open gaps down and reverses the green futures (overnight head-fake); MSFT loses add-gate authority (size_authority flips down) or XLK loses RS leadership; VIX breaks >20 / blow-off unwind accelerates.
evidence: XLK leading RS rank 1, FRESH BUY, Expansion/tailwind
Charter P1: cycle + risk-on gate 0.73 + validated cycles risk_on
holdings.exit_plan: Add is measured; stop at a decisive loss of add-gate authority or an XLK RS-leadership break. Toward Prophet t1 801 with re-confirmation; trim into strength if blow-off caution resolves to the downside.

holdings.rationale: Keep trimming despite the NQ reversal, because MU's case against is standalone and tape-independent: the engine gate is BLOCKED by a hard veto (cycle_blocked) with a 'political_crowd_trap' divergence on an already-EXTENDED name, it is the book's LARGEST single-name risk (9.57%), it is underwater (-3.16%), and it has NO active Prophet plan (held_without_active_plan). On the tape, the memory-relevant read is Korea, not broad US tech: KOSPI -2.62% keeps memory/semis genuinely soft overnight even as NQ turns green. Trim STANDARD not deep because the SMH basket is still FRESH BUY (rank 1) and the name's own lenses remain bullish, and it is only a 3-day position (anti-churn).
holdings.why_now: The hard cycle veto + extension + largest-risk + no Prophet plan are unchanged, and Korea memory weakness (KOSPI -2.62%) persists tonight. Reducing the oversized, veto-blocked name is the right de-risk regardless of the broad-tape bounce.
holdings.falsifier: MU cycle veto clears to bullish AND Korea memory stabilizes (KOSPI recovers) AND MU reclaims an active Prophet plan — that combination would say I over-trimmed.
evidence: engine gate BLOCKED: cycle_blocked hard veto
holdings.expected_horizon: hold residual 2-6 weeks pending veto clearance
holdings.exit_plan: Trim standard now; full exit if cycle_blocked persists and the name breaks its 20d trend, re-evaluate add only if the hard veto clears and a Prophet plan activates.

holdings.rationale: Lighten the trim from standard to light, because the tape reason is gone but the structural reason stands. Gone: 'tech is tonight's weak corner' — NQ is now +0.58% and leading, so the risk-off urgency behind a heavier trim has evaporated. Standing: AAPL carries an explicit DISTRIBUTION divergence (expensive + lagged 13F net-selling -> late-stage), has NO active Prophet plan, is my oldest position (69 days, +12%), and the blow-off-unwind caution (bubble_ext 77%) is live. That still justifies taking partial gains on a plan-less, distribution-flagged late-stage name — just lightly, not aggressively, into a green open.
holdings.why_now: Still the cleanest place to take partial profit (distribution divergence + no Prophet plan + oldest +12%), but the tech-selloff that argued for a bigger trim did not materialize, so I only trim light.
holdings.falsifier: The distribution divergence clears (13F net-buying returns) or AAPL regains a Prophet plan with gate authority — would argue for holding the full position.
holdings.exit_plan: Light trim now (bank partial gain); exit the remainder if the distribution divergence deepens or AAPL breaks its 50d trend.

falsifiers: US cash open gaps down and reverses tonight's green futures (overnight head-fake), confirming an offshore-led risk-off reached the US — would reverse the MSFT add.
VIX breaks above ~20 or the blow-off / bubble_ext (77%) unwind accelerates intraday — shift to crash posture, cut beta.
MSFT loses add-gate authority (size_authority flips down) or XLK loses RS leadership — remove the add rationale.
WTI breaks below ~85 or XLE loses #1 RS rank — removes the XOM ballast thesis.
MU cycle veto clears bullish AND KOSPI/Korea memory recovers — would say the MU trim was wrong.

sector rotation / RS + cycle engine (XLK leading FRESH BUY, XLE #1 RS)

args.expected_failure_mode: A tech-led blow-off unwind (bubble_ext 77%, thinning breadth, HY widening) hits at the US cash open DESPITE the green futures — the green overnight tape proves a head-fake. The measured MSFT add is then underwater immediately and the AAPL/MU trims prove to have been too light, while XOM fails to offset because oil is also soft. The elevated ~65% cash cushion limits the damage but does not prevent the add from bleeding.
args.cash_rationale: Cash stays elevated (~65%), above the 50% line flagged by lesson.v1.US_ONLY.cash_opportunity_cost, and I am justifying it explicitly rather than force-deploying into unconfirmed names. Justification: (1) DEGRADED DATA — the in-house dashboard is stale by directive and cannot see the live tape, so I can only partially verify the open; this is exactly the degraded-data condition the lesson allows. (2) GENUINE FRAGILITY — 'fragility building 54/100' (cheap VIX, thinning breadth, HY widening, index near 1y high on weak breadth), live bubble_ext 77% blow-off caution, elevated overnight risk_state (4/7 intl down, Europe -1%+, KOSPI -2.62%, VIX +2.2%), and a ROTATE_DEFENSIVE shadow posture. (3) RECORD OF REJECTED CANDIDATES after deeper search: MSFT is the ONLY name in the universe with genuine add authority, and I deployed into it; the cycle engine's entry list (XLB/XLC/XLI/XLK/XLRE/XLU/XLY) is ETF-only and ETFs are prohibited; Prophet discovery names (KVYO/LRN/LRCX/ACMR) are all pre-trigger 'wait' (not actionable); other held names (AAPL/MU) are plan-less and being trimmed. Confirmation-over-prediction says I do not buy unconfirmed names merely to lower a cash ratio. I lean back in via the one authorized add and hold the rest in cash overnight.
args.liquidity_notes: All four names are highly liquid US large/mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, XOM) plus a liquid large-cap semi (MU); trims and the measured MSFT add are small relative to ADV and settle at the open with no liquidity constraint.
args.sold_note: Trimming MU (standard) — oversized, hard cycle veto, Korea memory weak. Trimming AAPL (light, reduced from standard) — distribution divergence and partial profit-take, but lighter because the tech-weak-corner premise reversed. No full exits.

Caution is offshore+structural (KOSPI -2.62%, DAX -1.18%, Euro Stoxx -0.87%, VIX +2.2% off 15.41, gold +1.49%) plus 'fragility building 54/100' and live bubble_ext 77%. decision_memo.alternatives: 1) HOLD the queued book unchanged — rejected: ignores that the open stabilized and leaves the one authorized add on the table. 2) Full risk-off / raise cash further — rejected: US futures are green, not selling; that would be predicting a head-fake. 3) Aggressive re-add across tech — rejected: fragility building + bubble caution + ROTATE_DEFENSIVE argue for a measured single add only.
decision_memo.timing: Settles at the next OPEN, not now. The MSFT add is explicitly conditioned on the stabilized open the live tape shows; if the cash open gaps down it becomes a head-fake and the add is the first thing I cut.
decision_memo.risk_deliberation: Weighed 'lean back in (stabilized tape)' against live fragility (bubble_ext 77%, thinning breadth, HY widening, ROTATE_DEFENSIVE shadow). Resolution: a measured medium add into the single gate-authorized name in the leading FRESH-BUY sector, funded in character by trimming two flagged/plan-less names; gross stays well under the 0.43 offense budget and cash stays elevated as the primary risk cushion.
